findings.title: Receive from closed channel
findings.detail: Buffered values are still received first; then receives return immediately with the zero value and ok == false (v, ok := <-ch).

findings.title: nil channel blocks forever
findings.detail: Both send and receive on a nil channel block forever (deadlock if nothing else runs); useful to disable a select case.

findings.title: Double close panics
findings.detail: Closing an already closed channel panics.

findings.title: range ends after drain
findings.detail: range receives the remaining buffered values and exits when the channel is closed and empty.
